# Playable Ideas

> A collection of browser audio toys, each built around one mechanism. Each
> toy carries a markdown spec written so an agent can rebuild the mechanism
> from it alone, in another language, another audio framework, or hardware.
> Licence: CC0.

## Specs

- [motif-memory](toys/motif-memory/spec.md): Memory is a state of a voice, not a structure beside the ensemble.
- [markov](toys/markov/spec.md): A first-order chain gives every state exactly one future — a local grammar, and no phrase.
- [statistical-feedback](toys/statistical-feedback/spec.md): Dice have no memory, and the ear hears the difference.
- [possibles](toys/possibles/spec.md): Existing and mattering are different questions, and an instrument can let you answer them one at a time.
